name: Hin wa Bokura no Fuku no Kami ~Binbou no Kami-sama Datte Shiawase ni Naritai to Omotteiru no da~
original_name: 貧は僕らの福の神～貧乏の神さまだって幸せになりたいと思っているのだ～
source:
A beautiful girl Yoshino transferred to Academy Touju, attracting the attention of many boys at the school. But rumours spread that any boy that gets near her will fall into financial misfortune and they began to distance themselves from her. Some kind girls offered a helping hand, but were struck extremely hard into poverty. Soon she found herself isolated.

However, Yoshino's curse doesn't scare Daichi – he's already as poor as he could be. She wondered if he was fated to be with her and revealed herself as the god of poverty. She used to be a zashiki-warashi and believed that if the aura of poverty around her were to be completely cleansed, then she would return to normal. He agreed to help her out by staying by her side so that no incidents would happen, but she also wanted him to help those girls who she had unwillingly cursed. Thus begins his life together with the girls at the run-down Sanshunkan dormitory.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/08/01/august-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
美少女芳乃转学到藤寿学园，吸引了校内众多男生的目光。然而，有传言称靠近她的男生都会遭遇经济上的不幸，于是男生们纷纷与她保持距离。几位善良的女生伸出援手，却也遭受了沉重的贫穷打击。很快，芳乃发现自己被彻底孤立了。

不过，芳乃的诅咒吓不倒大知——他本来就穷得不能再穷了。芳乃猜想他是否就是自己命中注定的人，于是表明自己是贫穷之神。她原本是一位座敷童子，相信只要将身边的贫穷气息彻底净化，就能恢复正常。大知答应待在她身边帮助她，防止意外发生；但芳乃也希望他能帮助那些被她无意中诅咒的女孩们。就这样，他与女孩们在破旧的三春馆宿舍开始了共同生活。

[引自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/08/01/august-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
